function.description: For managed-site relation queries, return managed=true on first match across Primary/Secondary/Anchor, and return managed=false only after all three are checked with no match. For runtime managed-site detail controller/WLC queries that include serial number, do not use api_getPnP*. Use get_device_details to resolve canonical networkDeviceId, then call this API.
function.name: api_getSecondaryManagedAPLocationsForSpecificWirelessController

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

networkDeviceId.description: Obtain the network device ID value by using the API call GET: /dna/intent/api/v1/network-device/ip-address/${ipAddress}.

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

siteId.description: The site id of the managed ap location.

siteNameHierarchy.description: The site name hierarchy of the managed ap location.
